experiment: Case15 C native DD camera_encoder control strength ablation; gain 1.0 exact baseline and gain 0.5 treatment, same source/target-view inputs, stage2 endpoint, seed and official weights.
visual_review: At f0 both equal the Stage2 endpoint. At f4 the gain0.5 person already fades more than the native baseline; by f12/f16 the person nearly disappears into the pale studio background. Source arm motion is not restored. Clear holistic quality regression.

pose_diagnostics.warning: Limb aggregate is not directly comparable because matched frames per joint change under severe fading; do not infer improved action from a lower limb average.

conclusion: Uniformly reducing camera_encoder control to 0.5 worsens the Stage3 fade. This rejects a simple overstrong-control explanation for this case, but not every possible nontrajectory control strategy.
